sectionGuide.showGuideHint: — what you'll do here and how to start

home.goal: You see a daily summary — how many appointments, revenue, and what needs attention. The dashboard automatically fills with data from your calendar and transactions.
steps: Add staff and services (the checklist below tells you what's left)
Share the booking widget link with clients
Monitor stats — appointments, revenue, no-shows
React to alerts — absences, low stock levels
home.painPoint: No more manually counting appointments and revenue. Everything in one place — including forecasts for upcoming days.

calendar.goal: Manage all salon appointments in one place — see each staff member's schedule, add and edit appointments with one click.
steps: Make sure you've added staff and set working hours
Click an empty slot in the calendar to add an appointment
Select a client, service, and staff member
The appointment appears in the calendar with the staff member's assigned color
Share the widget — clients will book themselves 24/7
calendar.painPoint: No more paper calendars and phone chaos during treatments. Clients book themselves, even at 11 PM.

clients.goal: You have a complete client database with visit history, notes, and tags. Profiles are created automatically from online bookings.
steps: Add clients manually or import from a CSV file
Or wait — a profile is created automatically with the first online booking
Add tags (VIP, regular) and notes (allergies, preferences)
Filter clients by tags, purchase categories, or time since last visit
clients.painPoint: No more sticky notes and notebooks. Every client has a full profile — you know who's VIP, who hasn't visited in a while, and who to call.

services.goal: Your online price list. Services, categories, prices, and duration — this is what clients see in the booking widget.
steps: Create service categories (e.g. Face, Nails, Body)
Add services with price, duration, and description
Assign staff to services — each one performs different treatments
Optional: add effect photos or CSV import
services.painPoint: Without services, clients can't book online. Add them once — update the price list in one place, and the widget refreshes automatically.

staff.goal: Add team members (or yourself), assign services, and set working hours. Without staff, the calendar won't show available slots.
steps: Click 'Add employee' — even if you work alone, add yourself
Enter name, position, email, and phone
Set working hours for each day of the week
Assign services that the staff member performs
Choose a color — appointments will be marked this way in the calendar
staff.painPoint: Without staff, nothing works — the calendar is empty and clients can't book. This is the first step to launching the system.

widgets.goal: The booking widget is your online calendar. Paste it on your website or share the link — clients book 24/7.
steps: Copy the widget link and share on Facebook / Instagram
Get the embed code and paste on your website
Create a promotional widget with a first-visit discount
Track stats — how many people visited the widget and how many booked
widgets.painPoint: Clients book even at 11 PM while you rest. No phone calls during treatments — the system does it for you.

timeOff.goal: Manage vacations, sick leave, and training for your team. Absences automatically block slots in the booking calendar.
steps: Click 'Add absence'
Select employee, type (vacation, sick leave, training) and dates
Add an optional note
Calendar slots will be automatically blocked — clients won't book during this time
timeOff.painPoint: No more manually blocking slots when someone's on vacation. Add the absence once — the rest happens automatically.

stats.goal: Revenue, occupancy, top services, top staff, no-shows — everything in one place with charts and CSV export.
steps: Select period: daily, weekly, or monthly
Analyze revenue and occupancy charts
Check which services and staff generate the most
Export data to CSV for your accountant or own analysis
stats.painPoint: No more counting in Excel. See trends, compare months, and make decisions based on data, not hunches.

settings.goal: Configure your salon profile, client notifications, booking rules, and external integrations.
steps: Complete your salon profile — name, address, logo, branding colors
Configure SMS/email notifications (confirmation, reminder)
Set booking rules — minimum advance time, cancellation
Connect integrations — Google Calendar, payment gateways
settings.painPoint: Your logo and colors are displayed in the booking widget. Professional look = more client trust.

conversations.goal: All client conversations — SMS, email, WhatsApp — in one place. No more switching between apps.
steps: Configure communication integration in Settings → Integrations
Client messages will appear automatically on the list
Reply directly from the panel — SMS, email, or WhatsApp
Filter contacts by tags and message history
conversations.painPoint: No more searching for SMS and emails in different apps. One view = all conversations with every client.

pipeline.goal: Track the client journey from first contact to treatment package completion. See who needs attention.
steps: Clients automatically progress through stages: booking → 1st visit → follow-up visits → completion
Drag cards between columns to manually change the stage
Click a card to see the client's full history
Pay attention to the 'Did not show' column — these clients need action
pipeline.painPoint: See how many clients 'got stuck' after the first visit. You can call them before they go to the competition.

accounting.goal: Financial reports are generated automatically: daily cash report, VAT, staff commissions, export for your accountant.
steps: Select date range and browse reports
Check the daily cash report — cash, card, online totals
Generate VAT report for tax settlements
Export data to CSV/PDF and send to your accountant
accounting.painPoint: No more manual revenue counting. Close the salon, check the daily report — everything adds up.

products.goal: Manage retail products in your salon — catalog, stock levels, deliveries, and sales reports.
steps: Add products in the Catalog tab — name, price, EAN code, supplier
Monitor stock levels — the system warns when a product is running low
Record deliveries from suppliers with purchase prices
Browse sales reports and margins
products.painPoint: You know how many products are on the shelf and when to order the next delivery. No surprises during inventory.

recipes.goal: Assign products used for each service — the system automatically calculates material costs and shows your real profit (True Profit) per treatment.
steps: Select a service from the list on the left
Add products used during the treatment — e.g. base, polish, oil
Enter quantity and unit (pcs, ml, g) for each ingredient
The system automatically calculates material costs based on purchase prices from the product catalog
Check the True Profit card — see the real margin after deducting material costs
recipes.painPoint: Know how much you really earn per treatment — not the gross price, but the real profit after deducting product costs. This is your true margin.

consultation.goal: Create digital consultation cards, collect GDPR signatures, and record voice notes — all in one place instead of paper documentation.
steps: Deploy a ready-made card template (e.g. Face, Nails) with one click in the Templates tab
Go to the Cards tab — select a client and template, fill in the consultation card
Record a voice note (max 2 min) — AI automatically extracts products, tags, and next visit suggestions
Red flags (allergies, medications) appear automatically at the top of the client profile
consultation.painPoint: No more paper cards and notebooks. Digital documentation with GDPR signature, always at hand — even when the client returns after a year.

support.goal: The AI Assistant knows the entire Beauty Calendar platform. Ask about anything — configuration, features, troubleshooting.
steps: Type your question in the chat — in your own words
Use quick actions to ask common questions with one click
The assistant responds instantly with specific instructions
If you need human help — write to support@beautyfunnel.pl
support.painPoint: No need to search documentation. Ask, get an answer right away — like talking to an expert who knows the entire system.

newFaq.title: Frequently asked
newFaq.subtitle: Have a question? We probably already have the answer.
newFaq.q1: Do I need to sign a contract?
newFaq.a1: No. Beauty Calendar works on a monthly basis with no commitments. You can cancel anytime with one click.
newFaq.a2: On average 10-15 minutes. Add services, staff, working hours — and you're done. We also offer free help with migration from other systems.
newFaq.q3: Can I transfer data from Booksy/Fresha?
newFaq.a3: Yes! Our team will help you transfer your client list and visit history for free. Write to us at support@beautycalendar.pl.
newFaq.a4: AI analyzes your data (bookings, no-shows, revenue) and automatically suggests optimizations. You don't need to configure anything — it works from day one.
newFaq.a5: Yes, Beauty Calendar works as a PWA (Progressive Web App). Add to home screen and use it like a native app on iOS and Android.
newFaq.a6: We offer support via chat, email, and phone. We respond within a maximum of 4 hours on business days.
